subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 5/5] mountd: retry unresolvable fsid lookups on the netlink downcall

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to retry unresolvable file system ID (fsid) lookups when the netlink downcall fails. The fsid lookup is moved out of the nfsd_handle_fh function and into a separate lookup_fsid function, which returns one of three possible outcomes: FSID_LOOKUP_ANSWER (definitive), FSID_LOOKUP_RETRY (not resolvable yet), or FSID_LOOKUP_IGNORE (unusable request). If the lookup fails initially, it will be retried on the same RETRY_SEC cadence as pipefs requests. This change addresses issues with spurious ESTALE errors and improves handling of unmounted autofs submounts.
